test.title: A podcast you enjoy listening to

document.cue: Describe a podcast you enjoy listening to.

text: The podcast I'd like to talk about is Hardcore History by Dan Carlin, an American presenter who tells stories about major events in world history.

I found it by accident about a year ago. I was looking for something in English to practise my listening, and a friend sent me an episode series called Wrath of the Khans, about Genghis Khan and the Mongol Empire. Since that part of history is closely connected to Central Asia, I was hooked straight away.

The episodes are extremely long — some last four or five hours — so I usually listen in parts. I put it on during my commute, when I'm cooking, or on long bus journeys between cities. One episode can easily last me a whole week.

What I enjoy most is the way he tells the stories. He doesn't just list dates and battles; he makes you imagine what it actually felt like to be a soldier or a farmer at the time. He also admits when historians disagree, which I really respect. And as a bonus, my listening skills have improved enormously, because he speaks quite fast and uses a lot of sophisticated vocabulary.
So for me it's the perfect combination of entertainment and learning, and I've recommended it to almost everyone I know.
